_comment: Carson's discovery watchlist: real company job boards with working adapter configs. Import with `npx tsx src/cli.ts db import --json examples/job-sites.seed.json`, then delete or disable (scrape_enabled: false) the ones you don't want. Re-importing updates rows by name. Disabled rows say why in notes (no API, bot walls, or poor fit for a frontend search). Provider configs are documented in CLAUDE.md.

job_sites.name: a11y Jobs
job_sites.notes: Disabled 2026-10-01 after the first full run: aggregator surfaced universities, government, and staffing firms; all archived.

job_sites.name: Ancestry
job_sites.notes: Lehi, UT; consumer product at scale, design systems relevant

job_sites.name: Best Buy
job_sites.notes: Not scannable (checked 2026-10-01): jobs.bestbuy.com is a legacy client-rendered site with no JSON API. Add individual roles with /interested.

job_sites.notes: SLC area; acquired Divvy, has Utah engineering presence

job_sites.notes: Disabled 2026-10-01: osv-chegg.wd5 board page loads but every CXS jobs request returns 422 (any site/dc). Retry later with discover --site Chegg.
